quote: С 20 сентября 2024 года Указом № 367 запрещены операции по приобретению, отчуждению токенов за деньги (в том числе электронные) на зарубежных площадках

subject: CA
value_text: Bitunix Innovation Limited (Hong Kong) holds an active foreign money services business registration with FINTRAC, status Registered, covering virtual currency services; a second entity, Bitunix Fintech LLC, is also Registered.
quote:
Legal Name: BITUNIX INNOVATION LIMITED,
 Operating Name: BITUNIX INNOVATION LIMITED

subject: CA
value_text: The Interac e-Transfer service is operated by Interac Corporation, the national interbank network behind Canadian debit and transfer services.
quote: offered through Interac Corporation

subject: CA
value_text: Interac e-Transfer is the dominant domestic deposit rail, moving funds between accounts at participating Canadian banks and other financial institutions.
quote: a Canadian funds transfer service between personal and business accounts in participating Canadian banks and other financial institutions

subject: CA
value_text: Two-layer regime: CSA authorization decisions as a Crypto Asset Trading Platform, plus mandatory FINTRAC registration as a money services business (or foreign MSB) covering virtual-currency dealing.
quote: Before beginning to operate in Canada, you must register your money services business or foreign money services business with FINTRAC.

subject: CA
value_text: Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA), the umbrella of provincial and territorial securities regulators, oversees retail crypto trading platforms and publishes the list of platforms authorized to serve Canadians.
quote: Crypto Platforms Authorized to Do Business with Canadians

subject: CA
value_text: The Canada Revenue Agency requires crypto-asset users to report dispositions as either business income (or losses) or capital gains (or losses), depending on circumstances.
quote: you must report business income (or losses) or capital gains (or losses) from dispositions

subject: CH
value_text: Bank transfer in Swiss francs is the local deposit path; instant payments over the SIC infrastructure can be made around the clock, every day of the year.
quote: Les paiements instantanés peuvent être effectués 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, toute l'année, sans exception.

subject: CH
value_text: Switzerland does not apply MiCA: anyone operating a crypto-asset business model must first check whether Swiss financial-market law imposes authorisation or affiliation duties, assessed by FINMA.
quote: Quiconque entend exploiter un modèle d'affaires reposant sur des cryptoactifs doit vérifier, avant de commencer à exercer son activité, si le droit des marchés financiers prévoit des obligations d'autorisation ou d'assujettissement.

subject: CH
value_text: FINMA, the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority, handles authorisation and supervision questions for crypto-asset business models under Swiss financial-market law.
quote: La FINMA traite un nombre important de projets en lien avec les cryptoactifs.

subject: CH
value_text: For private individuals, buying and selling payment tokens is treated like transactions in traditional means of payment: resulting gains are non-taxable capital gains (losses non-deductible), while holdings are subject to cantonal wealth tax at market value.
quote: Les bénéfices ou les pertes qui en résultent constituent, dans le cadre de la fortune privée des personnes physiques, des gains en capital non imposables ou des pertes en capital non déductibles

subject: CL
value_text: Electronic funds transfers (Transferencias Electrónicas de Fondos, TEF) predominate among person-to-person payments in Chile by amounts involved, according to the Central Bank of Chile's Payment Systems Report, making interbank TEF transfers the default rail for funding exchange accounts in pesos.
quote: Considerando los montos involucrados, predominan los pagos con Transferencias Electrónicas de Fondos (TEF) entre personas.

subject: CL
value_text: Under Article 5 of Chile's Fintech Law (Ley Fintec), only entities registered in the Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros administered by the CMF may professionally provide the regulated services — crowdfunding platforms, alternative transaction systems, intermediation and custody of financial instruments, order routing, and credit or investment advice — the registration regime crypto platforms operate under.
quote: Artículo 5.- Servicios regulados y obligación de inscripción. Sólo podrán dedicarse en forma profesional a la prestación de servicios de plataforma de financiamiento colectivo, sistema alternativo de transacción, intermediación de instrumentos financieros, enrutamiento de órdenes, asesoría crediticia, asesoría de inversión y custodia de instrumentos financieros, quienes estén inscritos en el Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros administrado por la Comisión.

subject: CL
value_text: The Comisión para el Mercado Financiero (CMF) is the authority charged by Chile's Ley Fintec with supervising the provision of the regulated fintech services — including intermediation and custody of financial instruments, a category the law extends to virtual financial assets (crypto-assets) — with power to adopt preventive or corrective measures to protect investors.
quote: Corresponderá a la Comisión para el Mercado Financiero fiscalizar la prestación de los servicios antes indicados. Para ello contará con las atribuciones que le confieren esta ley y su ley orgánica, incluyendo la facultad de adoptar las medidas preventivas o correctivas que se estimen necesarias para el debido resguardo de los inversionistas.

subject: CL
value_text: Chile's tax authority (Servicio de Impuestos Internos) ruled in Oficio 963, de 14-05-2018 that income from buying and selling cryptocurrencies is classified under No. 5 of Article 20 of the Income Tax Law (LIR) and is subject to that law's general income taxes, while the sale of bitcoins or other virtual assets is not subject to VAT because it involves intangible goods.
quote: 963, de 14-05-2018) TRIBUTACIÓN QUE AFECTA A LAS RENTAS OBTENIDAS EN LA COMPRA Y VENTA DE CRIPTOMONEDAS – RENTAS CLASIFICADAS EN EL N° 5, DEL ART. 20 DE LA LIR – LA VENTA DE BITCOINS U OTROS ACTIVOS VIRTUALES O DIGITALES, NO SE ENCUENTRA AFECTA A IVA POR RECAER EN ESTE CASO SOBRE BIENES INCORPORALES.

subject: CO
value_text: PSE (Pagos Seguros en Linea), operated by ACH Colombia, is the dominant online funding rail: users authorize a debit from their savings, checking or electronic-deposit accounts through their own bank's online banking.
quote: PSE es el botón de Pagos Seguros en Línea, un servicio de ACH Colombia que le permite a las empresas vender o recaudar a través de Internet, en el cual los clientes o usuarios autorizan mediante la banca virtual de su banco el débito de los fondos desde sus cuentas de ahorro, corrientes o depósitos electrónicos.

subject: CO
value_text: Colombia has no crypto licensing regime: the SFC warns that it does not supervise, regulate, oversee, endorse or grant permits for transactions or business models based on virtual assets, so crypto exchanges serving Colombians operate without a local licence.
quote: La Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) advierte a la ciudadanía en general que este organismo de control no supervisa, ni regula, ni vigila, ni avala, ni otorga permisos para realizar transacciones o desarrollar modelos de negocio basados en activos virtuales, popularmente conocidos como “criptomonedas”.

subject: CO
value_text: The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) is the authority that supervises the Colombian financial system, with the objective of preserving its stability, security and confidence and protecting investors, savers and the insured.
quote: La Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia tiene por objetivo supervisar el sistema financiero colombiano con el fin de preservar su estabilidad, seguridad y confianza, así como, promover, organizar y desarrollar el mercado de valores colombiano y la protección de los inversionistas, ahorradores y asegurados.

subject: CO
value_text: DIAN's unified crypto-assets ruling (Concepto Unificado sobre Criptoactivos) treats crypto as assets: Colombian residents who hold crypto-assets must include them in the wealth section of their annual income tax return.
quote: los residentes colombianos que tengan en su patrimonio criptoactivos deben incluirlos en su declaración anual del impuesto sobre la renta y complementarios, específicamente en la sección de patrimonio

subject: DE
value_text: Instant SEPA credit transfers (Echtzeitüberweisungen) are the fastest bank funding rail in Germany: they are executed immediately around the clock on every calendar day, and the recipient's payment account is credited within ten seconds.
quote: Die hier genannten Fristen gelten nicht für Echtzeitüberweisungen. Diese werden an jedem Kalendertag rund um die Uhr sofort ausgeführt. Der Zahlungsdienstleister der zahlenden Person leitet den Zahlungsbetrag sofort weiter und der Zahlungsdienstleister der empfangenden Person macht den Zahlungsbetrag innerhalb von zehn Sekunden auf ihrem bzw. seinem Zahlungskonto verfügbar.

subject: DE
value_text: Crypto-asset services in Germany are licensed under EU Regulation 2023/1114 on markets in crypto-assets (MiCA), which governs the authorisation requirement, the exemptions and the authorisation procedure for crypto-asset service providers (CASPs).
quote: Die Verordnung (EU) 2023/1114 über Märkte für Kryptowerte (MiCAR) regelt die Zulassungspflicht, die Ausnahmen und das Zulassungsverfahren für Kryptowerte-Dienstleister (englisch: Crypto Asset Service Provider, abgekürzt: CASP)

subject: DE
value_text: BaFin (the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority, Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht) is the German regulator for crypto-asset services: anyone wishing to operate as a crypto-asset service provider in Germany must apply to BaFin for a MiCA authorisation.
quote: Wer in Deutschland als Kryptowerte-Dienstleister tätig sein will, muss bei der BaFin eine MiCAR-Zulassung beantragen.

subject: DE
value_text: Under § 23 EStG, private disposal transactions in 'other assets' — the category German tax guidance applies to privately held crypto-assets — are taxable only when the period between acquisition and sale does not exceed one year.
quote: Veräußerungsgeschäfte bei anderen Wirtschaftsgütern, bei denen der Zeitraum zwischen Anschaffung und Veräußerung nicht mehr als ein Jahr beträgt.

subject: ES
value_text: Bybit appears on the CNMV public list of crypto-asset service providers as BYBIT EU GMBH, operating under freedom-to-provide-services (LP) passporting with Austria as home state.
quote: BYBIT EU GMBH PSC EN RÉGIMEN DE LP (País de origen: AUSTRIA)

subject: ES
value_text: KuCoin appears on the CNMV public list of crypto-asset service providers as KUCOIN EU EXCHANGE GMBH, operating under freedom-to-provide-services (LP) passporting with Austria as home state.
quote: KUCOIN EU EXCHANGE GMBH PSC EN RÉGIMEN DE LP (País de origen: AUSTRIA)

subject: ES
value_text: OKX appears on the CNMV public list of crypto-asset service providers as OKX EUROPE LIMITED, operating under freedom-to-provide-services (LP) passporting with Malta as home state.
quote: OKX EUROPE LIMITED PSC EN RÉGIMEN DE LP (País de origen: MALTA)

subject: ES
value_text: Bizum, the instant mobile payment service created by the Spanish banking system, is the dominant domestic instant-payment rail and is offered as a funding method by some locally focused platforms.
quote: a payment service provider launched in 2016 as an initiative of the Spanish banking system

subject: ES
value_text: SEPA euro bank transfers are the primary deposit rail; Spain is a eurozone SEPA participant, so exchange deposits and withdrawals in euros ride standard SEPA credit transfers.
quote: The Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) is a payment integration initiative of the European Union for simplification of bank transfers denominated in euros.

subject: ES
value_text: EU MiCA regime: authorization as a crypto-asset service provider (proveedor de servicios de criptoactivos, CASP); Spain's transitional period for legacy Banco de España-registered providers ended on the first of July of this year, after which the old registry closed and CNMV handles registrations.
quote: El periodo transitorio en España finalizará el 1 de julio de 2026.

subject: ES
value_text: CNMV (Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores) is the competent authority supervising MiCA compliance for retail crypto in Spain; Banco de España oversees e-money and asset-referenced token issuance.
quote: La CNMV es la autoridad competente para la supervisión del cumplimiento de MiCA.

subject: ES
value_text: Gains from selling virtual currencies are treated as capital gains that constitute savings income and are integrated into the savings tax base of Spanish personal income tax (IRPF).
quote: constituyen renta del ahorro conforme a lo previsto en el artículo 46. b) de la Ley del IRPF

subject: FR
value_text: Euro credit transfers (virements) are the dominant local rail for funding accounts: the instant transfer (virement instantané) executes euro fund transfers in near real time, with funds made available to the beneficiary in less than 10 seconds, at any time, through a service available continuously, 7 days a week and 24 hours a day.
quote: Le virement instantané permet l’exécution de transferts de fonds en euros quasiment en temps réel grâce à la mise à disposition des fonds en moins de 10 secondes pour le bénéficiaire du paiement, à tout moment et à travers un service disponible en continu, 7 jours sur 7 et 24 heures sur 24.

subject: FR
value_text: Crypto platforms operate under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation: providers under France's previous national Pacte-law regime had until 1 July 2026 to obtain MiCA authorisation, the transition ended on 2 July, and authorisation is now mandatory to offer crypto-asset services in EU countries.
quote: Les prestataires actifs sous le régime national préexistant ont bénéficié d’une période transitoire courant jusqu’au 1er juillet 2026 pour obtenir cet agrément MiCA. Depuis le 2 juillet, la période de transition entre le régime national français introduit par la loi Pacte et le règlement européen sur les marchés de crypto-actifs MiCA est révolue. Le cadre européen s’applique désormais à l’ensemble des acteurs sans distinction et prévoit une autorisation obligatoire pour offrir des services sur les crypto-actifs dans les pays de l’Union européenne.

subject: FR
value_text: The Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF) authorises crypto-asset service providers and, under the mission the European legislator entrusted to national regulators, supervises PSCA compliance with their professional and good-conduct obligations.
quote: L’AMF continuera d’instruire les nouvelles demandes d’autorisation d’exercice qui lui sont ou seront soumises avec le même degré d’exigence. Ses équipes se consacrent également à la montée en puissance de la mission que le législateur européen a confiée aux régulateurs nationaux : celle de la supervision du respect par les PSCA de leurs obligations professionnelles et de bonne conduite.

subject: FR
value_text: For individuals managing private assets, France's tax administration (impots.gouv.fr) taxes crypto-asset capital gains at the flat-rate prélèvement forfaitaire unique (PFU) of 31.4% (12.8% income tax + 18.6% social levies) regardless of the number of transactions, with an option to elect the progressive income-tax scale instead.
quote: Les plus‑values réalisées dans le cadre de la gestion votre patrimoine privé sont imposées au prélèvement forfaitaire unique (PFU) de 31,4 % (12,8 % d’impôt + 18,6 % de prélèvements sociaux), quel que soit le nombre de transactions. Vous pouvez toutefois renoncer à ce PFU et choisir le barème progressif de l’impôt si cela vous avantage.

subject: GB
value_text: Faster Payments settles quicker than the legacy BACS and CHAPS systems, with per-transfer limits set by individual banks.
quote: The system offers faster settlement times than the long-established BACS and CHAPS systems.

subject: GB
value_text: Faster Payments (FPS) is the dominant GBP deposit rail — near-instant bank-to-bank transfers between UK accounts.
quote: a United Kingdom real-time gross settlement system which facilitates transfers between different banks' customer accounts within a few seconds

subject: GB
value_text: Cryptoasset firms doing business in the UK must hold FCA cryptoasset registration under the Money Laundering Regulations (MLRs) before providing in-scope services.
quote: You must register with us if you want to provide cryptoasset services that come within scope of the money laundering regulations (MLRs)

subject: GB
value_text: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) supervises firms carrying on cryptoasset activity in the United Kingdom under the anti-money-laundering regime.
quote: the FCA will be the Anti Money Laundering and Countering Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF) supervisor for firms carrying on certain cryptoasset activity

subject: GB
value_text: HMRC treats gains from selling, exchanging or giving away cryptoasset tokens as subject to Capital Gains Tax for individuals, above an annual tax-free allowance.
quote: Find out if you need to pay Capital Gains Tax on gains you make when you sell, exchange or give away cryptoasset tokens

subject: HK
value_text: FPS runs round the clock and supports payments in both the Hong Kong dollar and the renminbi; all banks and e-wallet operators in Hong Kong can participate.
quote: The FPS operates on 24x7 basis and supports payments in the Hong Kong dollar and the renminbi.

subject: HK
value_text: Faster Payment System (FPS) — Hong Kong's real-time payment rail connecting banks and e-wallet operators, implemented by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and operated by Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited.
quote: implemented by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and operated by Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (HKICL)

subject: HK
value_text: SFC virtual asset trading platform (VATP) licence, granted under the Securities and Futures Ordinance for security tokens and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance for non-security tokens; the SFC publishes a public list of formally licensed platform operators.
quote: This list sets out the names of virtual asset trading platform operators which are formally licensed by the SFC.

subject: HK
value_text: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) oversees retail crypto: centralised virtual asset trading platforms serving Hong Kong investors must be licensed by the SFC.
quote: actively marketing their services to Hong Kong investors, are required to be licensed and regulated by the SFC

subject: HK
value_text: Hong Kong imposes no capital gains tax and no value-added or sales tax, so retail crypto disposal gains of a capital nature are not taxed; only business trading profits sourced in Hong Kong fall under profits tax.
quote: There is no value-added or sales tax; no capital gains tax; no withholding tax on dividends and interest.

subject: ID
value_text: BI-FAST, Bank Indonesia's fast payment system, is the backbone of the country's retail payment system infrastructure, accelerating payments via various instruments and channels securely and affordably in real time and available 24/7, making it the default rail for funding accounts in rupiah.
quote: BI-FAST will assume its function as backbone of retail payment system infrastructure moving forward, thus accelerating payments via various instruments and channels securely and affordably in real time and available 24/7.

subject: ID
value_text: Crypto trading platforms operate under OJK Regulation POJK 27/2024 on the Trading of Digital Financial Assets Including Crypto Assets, which requires Digital Financial Asset trading operators to obtain licensed status and to submit periodic and incidental reports to OJK.
quote: POJK 27/2024 ini dimaksudkan untuk memastikan bahwa Penyelenggara Perdagangan Aset Keuangan Digital melakukan perdagangan Aset Keuangan secara teratur, wajar, transparan, dan efisien, serta memastikan penerapan tata kelola, manajemen risiko, integritas pasar, keamanan sistem informasi dan siber, pencegahan pencucian uang, dengan tetap memperhatikan pelindungan konsumen. POJK ini juga menetapkan kewajiban untuk memperoleh status izin bagi Penyelenggara Aset Keuangan Digital serta penyampaian pelaporan berkala dan insidental.

subject: ID
value_text: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) supervises digital financial assets including crypto assets for retail users, having taken over regulation and supervision duties from Bappebti under the mandate of Article 8 number 4 and Article 312 paragraph (1) of Law Number 4 of 2023 (P2SK Law).
quote: The objects of the transferred regulation and supervision duties from Bappebti to OJK includes Digital Financial Assets, including crypto assets and financial derivatives in the capital market. Meanwhile, the objects of the transferred regulation and supervision duties from Bappebti to BI includes financial derivatives with underlying, including instruments in the Money Market and Foreign Exchange Market (“PUVA"). The duties from Bappebti to OJK and Bank Indonesia was transferred in accordance with the mandate from Article 8 number 4 and Article 312 paragraph (1) of Law Number 4 of 2023 on the Development and Strengthening of the Financial Sector (“P2SK Law").

subject: ID
value_text: Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes states that transfers of crypto assets, now treated as equivalent to securities, are no longer subject to VAT, while income from crypto transactions remains subject to final Income Tax (PPh) Article 22 at 0.21% of the transaction value through domestic electronic trading operators (PPMSE) or 1% through foreign PPMSE.
quote: Dari sisi perpajakan, penyerahan aset kripto yang kini dipersamakan dengan surat berharga tidak lagi dikenakan PPN. Meskipun demikian, penghasilan yang diperoleh dari transaksi aset kripto tetap dikenai PPh Final Pasal 22. Besaran tarif PPh Pasal 22 yang dikenakan adalah sebesar 0,21% dari nilai transaksi apabila dilakukan melalui Penyelenggara Perdagangan Melalui Sistem Elektronik (PPMSE) Dalam Negeri, dan sebesar 1% apabila transaksi dilakukan melalui PPMSE Luar Negeri.

subject: IE
value_text: SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) offers near-real-time euro crediting, so funded exchanges can receive Irish bank deposits within seconds rather than business days.
quote: SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst), also called SEPA Instant Payment, provides for instant crediting of a payee, the delay being less than ten seconds.

subject: IE
value_text: SEPA euro bank transfers — Ireland is a euro-area SEPA participant, so exchange deposits and withdrawals in euro run over SEPA credit transfers.
quote: The Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) is a payment integration initiative of the European Union for simplification of bank transfers denominated in euros.

subject: IE
value_text: MiCA Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP) authorisation from the Central Bank of Ireland; authorisation is required for a CASP to operate in the EU.
quote: CASPs shall require authorisation in order to operate within the EU.

subject: IE
value_text: Before MiCA, crypto firms serving Ireland had to register with the Central Bank as Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs), an AML/CFT-focused registration now superseded by CASP authorisation.
quote: firms seeking to provide any VASP activities are required to be registered by the Central Bank as a VASP prior to the commencement of operations.

subject: IE
value_text: Central Bank of Ireland — designated national competent authority (NCA) for the authorisation and supervision of crypto-asset firms under MiCAR.
quote: The Central Bank has been designated as the NCA for the authorisation and supervision of entities that are subject to MiCAR.

subject: IE
value_text: Irish Revenue applies no special crypto tax rules: for individuals, gains on disposal of crypto-assets are treated under Capital Gains Tax like other assets, with the standard annual personal exemption.
quote: CGT is a tax on gains that arise on the disposal of assets such as land, buildings, shares, and crypto-assets.

subject: IN
value_text: Binance is registered as a reporting entity with India's Financial Intelligence Unit (announced August 2024, described by Binance as its nineteenth global regulatory milestone).
quote: Binance has successfully registered as a reporting entity with India's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

subject: IN
value_text: Bybit registered with FIU-IND (announcement dated February 2025) after settling a monetary penalty for earlier operation without registration.
quote: has successfully registered with FIU-IND, reinforcing its commitment to regulatory compliance in India

subject: IN
value_text: KuCoin is registered with India's Financial Intelligence Unit as a Reporting Entity (announced March 2024, among the first offshore exchanges to do so).
quote: we have become among the first global crypto exchanges to register with India's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)

subject: IN
value_text: UPI accounts for the overwhelming majority of digital payments in India and is the largest real-time payment system in the world.
quote: As of 2025, UPI accounts for 84% of digital payments in India.

subject: IN
value_text: Unified Payments Interface (UPI), the instant payment system operated by the National Payments Corporation of India, is the dominant local deposit rail for retail payments.
quote: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is an Indian instant payment system and protocol developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).

subject: IN
value_text: Crypto exchanges must register with FIU-IND as Virtual Digital Asset Service Providers (VDA SPs) in the Reporting Entity regime under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act; registration is a pre-requisite to operate.
quote: Registration of Virtual Digital Asset Service Providers (VDA SPs) in FIU India as Reporting Entity (RE)

subject: IN
value_text: Financial Intelligence Unit - India (FIU-IND), Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, oversees crypto (virtual digital asset) service providers under the anti-money-laundering framework.
quote: Ministry of Finance Department of Revenue Financial Intelligence Unit - India

subject: IN
value_text: Income from transfer of virtual digital assets is taxed at a flat rate of thirty per cent under Section 115BBH of the Income-tax Act, with no set-off or carry-forward of losses.
quote: income-tax calculated on the income from transfer of such virtual digital asset at the rate of thirty per cent

subject: IT
value_text: Instant SEPA credit transfers (bonifici istantanei) are the domestic funding rail: under Regulation (EU) 2024/886, providers offering credit transfers must offer instant ones too, reachable around the clock.
quote: I PSP che offrono ai propri USP un servizio di pagamento di invio e ricezione di bonifici offrono a tutti i loro USP un servizio di pagamento di invio e ricezione di bonifici istantanei.

subject: IT
value_text: Italy's licensing regime is the EU MiCAR framework: Legislative Decree 129/2024 adapts national law to Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 on markets in crypto-assets.
quote: Adeguamento della normativa nazionale al regolamento (UE) 2023/1114 del Parlamento europeo e del Consiglio, del 31 maggio 2023, relativo ai mercati delle cripto-attività

subject: IT
value_text: Banca d'Italia and Consob are Italy's authorities for crypto-asset markets under the national MiCAR decree (D.lgs. 129/2024), each within its own remit.
quote: La Banca d'Italia e la Consob possono, nell'ambito delle rispettive competenze, emanare disposizioni attuative del presente decreto, nonché del regolamento (UE) 2023/1114

subject: IT
value_text: Crypto gains are 'redditi diversi' under Article 67(1)(c-sexies) of the TUIR — gains from redemption, disposal, exchange or holding of crypto-assets — and fall under the substitute-tax regime of D.lgs. 461/1997 Article 5.
quote: le plusvalenze e gli altri proventi realizzati mediante rimborso o cessione a titolo oneroso, permuta o detenzione di cripto-attività, comunque denominate

subject: KE
value_text: M-Pesa is operated by Safaricom, Kenya's leading mobile network operator; bank transfers and cards play a secondary role next to mobile money.
quote: M-PESA was first launched by the Kenyan mobile network operator Safaricom

subject: KE
value_text: M-Pesa mobile money is the dominant local payment rail in Kenya, and the typical deposit route for Kenyan retail crypto users.
quote: by 2010 had become the most successful mobile-phone-based financial service in the developing world

subject: KE
value_text: VASP licence under the Virtual Assets Service Providers Act, 2025 (Act No. 20 of 2025), effective November 2025; licensing opens only once implementing Regulations are issued, and no VASP has yet been licensed to operate in or from Kenya.
quote: the licensing of VASPs will commence upon issuance of these Regulations. Currently CBK and CMA have not licensed any VASPs under the Act

subject: KE
value_text: The Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) and the Capital Markets Authority (CMA) are jointly designated to license, supervise and regulate virtual asset service providers in Kenya.
quote: The Act designates the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) and the Capital Markets Authority (CMA) as the regulators responsible for licensing, supervising, and regulating VASPs

subject: KE
value_text: Under the Finance Act, 2025, excise duty of 10% of the excisable value applies to fees charged on virtual assets transactions by virtual asset providers.
quote: Fees charged on virtual assets transactions by virtual asset providers N/A 10% of the excisable value

subject: KZ
value_text: AFSA's own 2024 results release names BN KZ Technologies Limited as Binance's local entity; the AFSA public register shows its licence AFSA-A-LA-2024-0028 as active since 25-09-2024 with Operating a Digital Asset Trading Facility among its regulated activities.
quote: Binance (BN KZ Technologies Limited) and Bybit (Bybit Limited) successfully transitioned from the FinTech Lab sandbox to the full regulatory status

subject: KZ
value_text: Bybit Limited holds AFSA licence AFSA-A-LA-2024-0027, shown on the AFSA public register as active since 25-09-2024, with Operating a Digital Asset Trading Facility among its regulated activities.
quote: Bybit Limited

subject: KZ
value_text: The National Bank of Kazakhstan's Instant Payment System (IPS) is the 24/7 interbank rail for instant transfers and payments between clients of different banks, including by mobile phone number.
quote: National Bank of Kazakhstan is announcing the launch of operation of an upgraded Instant Payment System’s platform (hereinafter, the IPS) designed for instant interbank transfers and payments in 24/7 mode.

subject: KZ
value_text: The law defines a digital asset as property created in electronic-digital form that is not a monetary unit of account and is not legal tender. Circulation sits with National Bank-licensed or registered operators or with AIFC participants holding the relevant permissions.
quote: digital asset – property created in electronic digital form with the assignment of a digital code, including with the use of cryptography and computer calculations, which is not a monetary unit of account and (or) legal tender

subject: KZ
value_text: Kazakhstan's Law on Digital Assets (No. 193-VII LRK of 6 February 2023) is the national statute, published in the Adilet official legal information system.
quote: Закон Республики Казахстан от 6 февраля 2023 года № 193-VII ЗРК.

subject: KZ
value_text: The Digital Assets Law states that a digital asset is not a monetary unit of account and is not legal tender in Kazakhstan. This page does not invent a personal-income-tax rate the statute does not publish.
quote: which is not a monetary unit of account and (or) legal tender

subject: MX
value_text: SPEI transfers settle within seconds through internet or mobile banking, addressed by CLABE, debit-card number, or an associated mobile number.
quote: realizar en cuestión de segundos pagos electrónicos... a través de la banca por internet o de la banca móvil

subject: MX
value_text: SPEI is the dominant local deposit rail: an interbank electronic payment system developed and operated by Banco de México, used for peso transfers via internet and mobile banking.
quote: un sistema desarrollado y operado por el Banco de México

subject: MX
value_text: Under Mexico's Ley Fintech, fintech firms operate as Instituciones de Tecnología Financiera (ITF) under an authorization issued by the CNBV and are enrolled in the SIPRES register of financial service providers.
quote: la autorización que emite la CNBV para que las ITF puedan operar, y se encuentren inscritas en el Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros (SIPRES)

subject: MX
value_text: The Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (CNBV) supervises and regulates the entities of the Mexican financial system, including the fintech institutions that serve retail crypto users.
quote: Supervisar y regular a las entidades integrantes del sistema financiero mexicano, y a las personas físicas y demás personas morales

subject: MY
value_text: DuitNow transfers cost nothing up to RM5,000; above that a 50 sen fee applies, and many banks waive it. Available via internet and mobile banking at banks nationwide and participating e-wallets.
quote: Send up to RM5,000 at no cost. For higher transfers, a 50 sen fee applies, though many banks may waive it.

subject: MY
value_text: DuitNow instant account-to-account transfer (Real-time Retail Payments Platform run by PayNet): instant send/receive using a mobile number or DuitNow ID across participating banks and e-wallets.
quote: Send money to friends, family or anyone instantly with just a mobile number or DuitNow ID.

subject: MY
value_text: Digital asset exchanges serving Malaysia are registered by the Securities Commission Malaysia as Recognized Market Operators (RMO) to establish and operate a digital asset exchange (DAX); running a DAX without SC authorisation is an offence under securities laws.
quote: Operating a DAX without authorisation from the SC is an offence under securities laws

subject: MY
value_text: Securities Commission Malaysia (SC), the statutory body regulating Malaysia's capital markets (digital asset exchanges fall under securities law).
quote: is a Malaysian statutory body with responsibility for the development and regulation of capital markets in the country

subject: MY
value_text: Income from active crypto activities such as trading, mining and exchange is subject to Malaysian income tax, with digital currencies classified as commodities that can constitute business income (Ministry of Finance, parliamentary reply).
quote: Income derived from digital cryptocurrency activities such as trading, mining, and exchange in Malaysia is subject to income tax

subject: NG
value_text: Peer-to-peer trading remains a widely used funding channel, a habit entrenched after the Central Bank of Nigeria's earlier directive restricting banks from processing crypto transactions.
quote: many Nigerians have said they will continue to use cryptocurrencies where they can and that they will switch to using peer-to-peer transactions

subject: NG
value_text: Central Bank of Nigeria guidelines permit banks to open designated accounts and provide settlement services for SEC-licensed virtual asset service providers, restoring a formal banking on-ramp for crypto platforms.
quote: Financial Institutions are permitted to undertake opening of designated accounts and provide designated settlement accounts and settlement services in their operations of accounts for VASPs

subject: NG
value_text: The dominant local deposit rail is the naira bank transfer over NIBSS Instant Payment (NIP), Nigeria's interbank instant-transfer system tracked by the Central Bank of Nigeria.
quote: Electronic transactions, facilitated by platforms like the NIBSS Instant Payment (NIP), have become increasingly popular.

subject: NG
value_text: Virtual Asset Service Providers register with the SEC through the Accelerated Regulatory Incubation Programme (ARIP); admitted entities receive an Approval-in-Principle, a conditional operating clearance ahead of full registration.
quote: An Approval-in-Principle confirms that an entity has satisfied the Commission's admission requirements for the Programme.

subject: NG
value_text: Retail crypto in Nigeria is overseen by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), whose remit over digital assets was cemented by the Investments and Securities Act, which repealed the earlier Act and recognises digital asset service providers.
quote: has assented to the Investments and Securities Bill (ISB) 2025, which repeals the Investments and Securities Act No. 29 of 2007

subject: NG
value_text: From 2026 profits from individual cryptocurrency transactions are taxed at a maximum rate of 25%, and virtual asset service providers pay corporate income tax on their operating profits.
quote: Starting in 2026, profits from individual cryptocurrency transactions in Nigeria will be taxed at a maximum rate of 25%.

subject: NZ
value_text: Binance New Zealand operates via Investbybit Limited, registered on the FSPR as FSP1003864 (status Registered, registration date 10-Sep-2022; verified live on the register). Binance's official blog confirms the launch; FSPR registration is not a licence or active regulatory oversight.
quote: Binance New Zealand has officially launched following successful registration as a Financial Service Provider on September 10, 2022!

subject: NZ
value_text: New Zealand retail banks began a phased rollout of a Confirmation of Payee service (payee-name checking before sending money) from late 2024, tightening bank-transfer security for deposits.
quote: New Zealand's retail banks will begin a phased rollout of the CoP service from November 2024

subject: NZ
value_text: Domestic NZD bank transfer: direct credits and automatic payments cleared through the Bulk Electronic Clearing System (BECS) administered by Payments NZ are the standard way to move money between New Zealand bank accounts.
quote: Payments NZ who administer the Bulk Electronic Clearing System (BECS). The scope of BECS includes direct debits, automatic payments, bill payments, and direct credits.

subject: NZ
value_text: No bespoke crypto licence: NZ-based crypto exchanges fall under 'operating a value transfer service' and must be registered on the Financial Service Providers Register (FSPR) under the Financial Service Providers (Registration and Dispute Resolution) Act, plus AML/CFT Act obligations.
quote: Exchanges allowing cryptoasset trading fall within the financial service category of ‘operating a value transfer service’.

subject: NZ
value_text: Financial Markets Authority (FMA) oversees retail crypto financial services in New Zealand; 'crypto asset service providers' is a named FMA service category, and crypto CFD providers need an FMA derivatives issuer licence.
quote: Providers offering crypto CFDs in New Zealand require a derivatives issuer licence from the FMA.

subject: NZ
value_text: Inland Revenue treats cryptoassets as a form of property for tax purposes; taxable cryptoasset income is returned under ordinary income tax rules (there is no separate crypto tax, and buying or selling cryptoassets is not subject to goods and services tax).
quote: Cryptoassets are treated as a form of property for tax purposes.

subject: PH
value_text: PESONet, the first automated clearing house under the National Retail Payment System, handles batch bank transfers for larger, non-urgent amounts.
quote: The Philippine EFT System and Operations Network (PESONet), the first ACH under the NRPS, was launched on 08 November 2017.

subject: PH
value_text: The GCash mobile wallet is the most widely used e-money option, with InstaPay support for interbank transfers.
quote: As of January 2025, GCash claims to have 81 million active users and 2.5 million sellers and merchants across the Philippines.

subject: PH
value_text: InstaPay, the BSP-overseen real-time interbank transfer scheme (capped per transaction), is the dominant instant deposit rail for banks and e-wallets.
quote: InstaPay is a real-time low-value EFT credit push payment scheme for transaction amounts up to P50,000.

subject: PH
value_text: BSP Certificate of Authority (COA) to operate as a Virtual Asset Service Provider, issued under BSP Circular No. 1108.
quote: How can an entity obtain a Certificate of Authority (COA) to operate as a VASP?

subject: PH
value_text: BSP maintains a public register of licensed VASPs; active non-bank entries include Coins.ph, Maya Philippines and PDAX — no major offshore exchange appears.
quote: List of Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASP) As of 31 May 2026

subject: PH
value_text: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), the central bank, oversees retail crypto platforms as Virtual Asset Service Providers under Circular No. 1108.
quote: Subject: Guidelines for Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASP)

subject: PH
value_text: The Department of Finance expects crypto-asset users to pay tax on their gains and has committed the Philippines to the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework.
quote: The government must ensure that crypto-asset users are paying their fair share of taxes and that no illicit financial activity goes unpunished

subject: PT
value_text: Domestic retail payments run over the Multibanco interbank network operated by SIBS, whose MB WAY app provides instant money transfers linked to mobile phone numbers.
quote: It is the largest interbank network in Portugal owned and operated by SIBS

subject: PT
value_text: SEPA euro bank transfers are the primary deposit rail; Portugal is a eurozone SEPA member, so exchanges accept euro payments from any Portuguese bank account using standard SEPA instruments.
quote: make cashless euro payments to any account located anywhere in the area, using a single bank account and a single set of payment instruments

subject: PT
value_text: Crypto platforms serving Portugal historically registered with Banco de Portugal as virtual asset service providers under the anti-money-laundering law; registered entities now operate under the EU MiCA transitional regime pending full crypto-asset service provider authorisation from Banco de Portugal.
quote: List of registered virtual asset service providers operating in the Portuguese territory, under the transitional regime foressen in article 143(3)(1st paragraph) of the MiCA Regulation

subject: PT
value_text: Banco de Portugal and the CMVM (Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários) are the designated competent authorities for crypto-asset markets under the law implementing the EU MiCA Regulation; Banco de Portugal handles prudential supervision and service-provider authorisation, CMVM handles market and conduct supervision.
quote: O Banco de Portugal é a autoridade competente responsável pela: i) Supervisão dos títulos iii e iv do Regulamento MiCA

subject: PT
value_text: Per the Portuguese Tax Authority, gains on crypto-assets that are not securities and are held for a period of 365 days or more are excluded from personal income taxation.
quote: detidos por um período igual ou superior a 365 dias são excluídos de tributação

subject: PT
value_text: Crypto capital gains not excluded from taxation are taxed at an autonomous rate of 28%, with the taxpayer able to opt for aggregation in the annual income-tax return.
quote: As mais-valias positivas não excluídas de tributação, são tributadas à taxa autónoma de 28%

subject: RU
value_text: The Faster Payments System (SBP) is the Bank of Russia's round-the-clock service for instant transfers between accounts at different banks by mobile phone number.
quote: Система быстрых платежей (СБП) — круглосуточный сервис Банка России, который позволяет мгновенно переводить деньги между счетами в разных банках по номеру мобильного телефона, оплачивать покупки, услуги и налоги, а также делать другие операции.

subject: RU
value_text: The law sets a transitional period until 1 July 2027, during which market participants must obtain licences and bring their activity into line with the new requirements. Unqualified investors may buy the most liquid crypto-assets after a test, capped at 300 thousand rubles a year through one intermediary.
quote: Закон вводит переходный период для участников рынка до 1 июля 2027 года. В течение этого времени они должны получить лицензии и привести свою деятельность в соответствие с новыми требованиями.

subject: RU
value_text: The Bank of Russia (CBR) is the authority publishing the domestic crypto-asset market rules: intermediated trades, crypto exchanges and digital depositories sit under the framework described in its 21 July 2026 release.
quote: Сделки с криптовалютами через посредников смогут совершать как неквалифицированные, так и квалифицированные инвесторы.

subject: RU
value_text: Paying with crypto inside the country remains prohibited. The same Bank of Russia release that sets the market rules restates that ban; it does not publish a dedicated retail capital-gains rate on that page.
quote: Важно, что расплачиваться криптовалютой внутри страны по-прежнему запрещено.

subject: SG
value_text: OKX SG PTE. LTD. is listed on the MAS Financial Institutions Directory as a Major Payment Institution authorised for Digital Payment Token Service and Cross-border Money Transfer Service
quote: OKX SG PTE. LTD. Incorporated in Singapore Licence Type/Status Major Payment Institution

subject: SG
value_text: PayNow is the consumer-facing proxy-addressing overlay on FAST, letting users pay via mobile number, NRIC or business number
quote: PayNow is an overlay central addressing service that runs on top of the FAST payment system.

subject: SG
value_text: FAST (Fast and Secure Transfers) is the instant Singapore-dollar interbank transfer rail used for exchange deposits
quote: FAST is an electronic funds transfer service that enables customers of participating entities to transfer Singapore dollar funds from one entity to another instantly.

subject: SG
value_text: Payment Services Act licensing: crypto exchanges are licensed payment service providers under the digital payment token service category, typically holding a Major Payment Institution licence
quote: Payment service providers are licensed to provide specified payment services under the Payment Services Act 2019 ("PS Act")

subject: SG
value_text: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) oversees retail crypto as a payment service
quote: Monetary Authority of Singapore

subject: SG
value_text: IRAS generally treats individuals' gains from buying and selling financial instruments, including digital tokens, as non-taxable personal investments; there is no capital gains tax
quote: Profits or losses derived from the buying and selling of shares or other financial instruments (including digital tokens) are generally viewed as personal investments.

subject: TH
value_text: PromptPay, launched in 2016, is the national payment infrastructure: money transfers via citizen ID, mobile number or bank account number through digital channels with lower fees.
quote: PromptPay has been launched since 2016 as a payment system infrastructure that expands user options to transfer money using their citizen ID, mobile phone number (or recipient’s other identification number) and bank account number via digital channels with lower fees.

subject: TH
value_text: A digital asset business operator must obtain a licence from the Minister of Finance on the SEC's recommendation, under Section 26 of the Emergency Decree on Digital Asset Businesses B.E. 2561 (2018); the SEC publishes the licensed exchange list.
quote: A digital asset business operator shall obtain a licence from the Minister upon the recommendation of the SEC.

subject: TH
value_text: The Bank of Thailand (BOT), the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Ministry of Finance jointly reviewed digital assets and deem it necessary to regulate their usage as a means of payment for goods and services.
quote: The Bank of Thailand (BOT), the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and Ministry of Finance (MOF) have jointly reviewed the benefits and risks of digital assets, and deem it necessary to regulate the usage of digital assets as a means of payment for goods and services, to avert potential impacts on the country's financial stability and economic system.

subject: TH
value_text: Gains from transferring cryptocurrency or digital tokens (the portion exceeding cost) are assessable income with 15% personal-income-tax withholding under the 2018 Revenue Code amendment; VAT at 7% is exempted for transfers through licensed exchanges, brokers and dealers from 1 January 2024.
quote: กำหนดให้หักภาษีเงินได้บุคคลธรรมดา ณ ที่จ่ายของเงินได้พึงประเมินดังกล่าวในอัตราร้อยละ 15 ของเงินได้

subject: TR
value_text: OKX TR Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu AŞ (formerly OKX Teknoloji AŞ) appears on SPK's list of crypto-asset service providers in operation — the temporary list under provisional article 11, which SPK notes is not an authorisation.
quote: OKX TR Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu AŞ

subject: TR
value_text: FAST (Fonların Anlık ve Sürekli Transferi) is the CBRT-operated instant payment system, independent of EFT: customers can send payment orders 24/7 and transfers complete in seconds.
quote: Fonların Anlık ve Sürekli Transferi (FAST) Sistemi, müşterilerin banka sistemleri üzerinden ödeme talimatlarını 7/24 gönderebilecekleri TCMB’nin bünyesinde geliştirilmiş ve TCMB tarafından işletilen EFT’den bağımsız bir sistemdir.

subject: TR
value_text: SPK publishes a temporary list of entities that declared they would continue operating under provisional article 11 of the Capital Markets Law. The Board states that presence on that list does not mean the entity is authorised under the relevant legislation.
quote: “Faaliyette Bulunanlar Listesi”nin varlığı, bu listede yer alan kuruluşların ilgili mevzuat uyarınca yetkilendirildiği anlamına gelmemektedir.

subject: TR
value_text: The Capital Markets Board of Türkiye (SPK) is the authority given regulation and supervision of crypto-asset service providers under Law No. 7518, published in the Official Gazette on 2 July 2024.
quote: 7518 sayılı “Sermaye Piyasası Kanunu’nda Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Kanun” 02.07.2024 tarihli ve 32590 sayılı Resmi Gazete’de yayımlanarak yürürlüğe girmiştir.

subject: TR
value_text: SPK's crypto-asset service-provider announcement sets licensing and the operating list; it does not publish a retail crypto-gains tax rate. This row records that absence rather than a figure we did not read from the Board.
quote: Söz konusu düzenleme ile ülkemizde faaliyet gösteren veya gösterecek olan kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcıları 6362 sayılı Sermaye Piyasası Kanunu (Kanun) kapsamında Kurulumuz düzenleme ve denetimi yetkisi altına alınmıştır.

subject: UA
value_text: The National Bank of Ukraine created the System of Electronic Payments (SEP) to settle hryvnia payments of banks and their clients inside Ukraine. SEP handles more than 99 percent of interbank payments in the country and has run 24/7 since the SEP-4 generation.
quote: Національний банк створив державну Систему електронних платежів (далі – СЕП) для забезпечення розрахунків банків та їхніх клієнтів у гривні в межах України.

subject: UA
value_text: The official card of Law 2074-IX still marks it as not in force. Until the linked Tax Code law takes effect, there is no operating licensing perimeter for virtual-asset service providers under this statute.
quote: Стан: Не набрав чинності

subject: UA
value_text: Ukraine's Law on Virtual Assets (No. 2074-IX of 17 February 2022) is adopted but has not entered into force. Its commencement is tied to a Tax Code amendment on virtual-asset operations.
quote: не набрав чинності

subject: UA
value_text: Because Law 2074-IX has not entered into force, there is no special virtual-asset tax schedule in that statute. The Tax Code amendments named on the law's official card are the missing switch.
quote: з дня набрання чинності законом України про внесення змін до Податкового кодексу України щодо особливостей оподаткування операцій з віртуальними активами

subject: US
value_text: Binance's US platform operator, BAM Trading Services Inc. (DBA Binance.us, Miami FL), appears on FinCEN's public MSB Registrant Search.
quote: BAM Trading Services Inc.

subject: US
value_text: An entity named Bitunix Fintech LLC (foreign-located, Kingstown, St Vincent and the Grenadines) appears on FinCEN's public MSB Registrant Search; identity match with the exchange rests on name and domicile only.
quote: Bitunix Fintech LLC

subject: US
value_text: OKX serves US customers through OKX INC. (San Jose, CA), which holds state money transmitter licences and appears on FinCEN's MSB Registrant Search.
quote: The OKX digital asset trading platform for United States customers is provided by OKX INC.

subject: US
value_text: Instant interbank payments are available via the Federal Reserve's FedNow Service, live since July 20, 2023, settling in near real-time at any time of day.
quote: The FedNow Service went live on July 20, 2023.

subject: US
value_text: ACH bank transfer is the dominant deposit rail; the ACH Network connects essentially all US bank accounts and is operated by the Federal Reserve's FedACH and The Clearing House's EPN.
quote: Virtually every bank account in the US, whether personal or commercial, is connected to the network.

subject: US
value_text: Federal baseline is FinCEN Money Services Business (MSB) registration via FinCEN Form 107, renewed every two years; exchanges additionally need state money transmitter licences.
quote: With few exceptions, each money services business (MSB) must register with the Department of the Treasury.

subject: US
value_text: FinCEN (Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, US Treasury) is the federal AML regulator; its guidance classifies virtual-currency exchangers as money transmitters, alongside state money-transmitter regulators.
quote: an administrator or exchanger is an MSB under FinCEN’s regulations, specifically, a money transmitter

subject: US
value_text: The IRS treats digital assets as property, not currency; disposals of investment holdings are taxed as capital gains or losses, and all digital-asset transactions must be reported.
quote: For U.S. tax purposes, digital assets are considered property, not currency.

subject: VN
value_text: NAPAS FastFund 247 is the dominant local funding rail: a real-time interbank transfer service provided by NAPAS to member banks and non-banking organizations, letting customers use cards or bank accounts to send and receive money in real time when funding accounts in Vietnamese dong.
quote: NAPAS FastFund 247 is the service provided by NAPAS to Member Organizations (Banks or Non-Banking Organizations), allowing customers of member organizations to use cards or bank accounts to transfer money and receive money in real-time by payment instruments and transaction channels

subject: VN
value_text: Crypto platforms operate under Government Resolution No. 05/2025/NQ-CP on piloting the crypto-asset market in Viet Nam, signed on 9/9/2025 and effective from 9/9/2025 with a 5-year pilot period, during which only organisations licensed by the Ministry of Finance may provide crypto-asset services.
quote: Ngày 9/9/2025, thay mặt Chính phủ, Phó Thủ tướng Hồ Đức Phớc đã ký ban hành Nghị quyết số 05/2025/NQ-CP của Chính phủ về việc triển khai thí điểm thị trường tài sản mã hóa tại Việt Nam. Nghị quyết này có hiệu lực thi hành kể từ ngày 9/9/2025; thời gian thực hiện thí điểm là 5 năm.

subject: VN
value_text: Under Vietnam's crypto-asset market pilot resolution, the Ministry of Finance (Bộ Tài chính) is the authority responsible for managing and supervising crypto-asset service providers, leading in coordination with the State Bank of Vietnam and the Ministry of Public Security.
quote: Bộ Tài chính có trách nhiệm: a) Chủ trì trình Chính phủ ban hành Nghị định quy định xử phạt vi phạm hành chính trong lĩnh vực tài sản mã hoá và thị trường tài sản mã hoá; b) Chủ trì, phối hợp với Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam, Bộ Công an quản lý, giám sát các tổ chức cung cấp dịch vụ tài sản mã hóa

subject: VN
value_text: Under the Ministry of Finance circular guiding tax policy for Vietnam's crypto-asset market pilot, individual investors — resident or non-resident — who transfer crypto assets through licensed crypto-asset service providers pay personal income tax at 0.1% of the price of each transfer.
quote: Theo Thông tư, về thuế thu nhập cá nhân, nhà đầu tư là cá nhân (không phân biệt cá nhân cư trú hay không cư trú) có hoạt động chuyển nhượng tài sản mã hóa qua tổ chức cung cấp dịch vụ tài sản mã hóa thuộc đối tượng nộp thuế thu nhập cá nhân theo tỷ lệ 0,1 % trên giá chuyển nhượng từng lần.

subject: ZA
value_text: PayShap launched with the country's four largest retail banks — Absa, First National Bank, Standard Bank and Nedbank — with more banks joining in later phases.
quote: the participation of the first cohort of banks, namely Absa, First National Bank, Standard Bank and Nedbank

subject: ZA
value_text: PayShap, the low-value real-time rapid payment platform driven by BankservAfrica and the Payments Association of South Africa, provides instant bank-to-bank payments across participating banks, alongside traditional EFT bank transfers.
quote: The initial rollout of PayShap, beginning on 13 March 2023, will offer consumers access to instant, real-time payments across participating banks

subject: ZA
value_text: Crypto asset service provider (CASP) licence: crypto assets were declared a financial product under the FAIS Act, so providers must be licensed as financial services providers; the FSCA publishes the list of authorised CASPs.
quote: LIST OF CRYPTO ASSET SERVICE PROVIDERS (CASPS) LICENSED UNDER THE FINANCIAL ADVISORY AND INTERMEDIARY SERVICES (FAIS) ACT, NO. 37 OF 2002

subject: ZA
value_text: The regime stems from the FSCA declaration of a crypto asset as a financial product under the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act (FSCA Communication of two-thousand-twenty-two).
quote: Declaration of a Crypto Asset as a Financial Product under the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act, 2002

subject: ZA
value_text: The Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) oversees retail crypto in South Africa; it licenses crypto asset service providers under the FAIS Act.
quote: The Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) commenced the licensing process for crypto asset service providers (CASPs)

subject: ZA
value_text: SARS applies normal income tax rules to crypto assets: gains are declared either as revenue (gross income) or, where capital in nature, under the capital gains tax paradigm.
quote: Normal income tax rules apply to crypto assets and affected taxpayers need to declare crypto assets' gains or losses as part of their taxable income.
